influxdb.tableQuery:
-- Newest points of the last hour, LIMIT 50 per series. No row means no point is newer: widen 1h below.
SELECT * FROM "c0".."Order\"Items" WHERE time > now() - 1h ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50
influxdb.selectQuery:
-- Newest points of the last hour, LIMIT 50 per series. No row means no point is newer: widen 1h below.
SELECT * FROM "c0".."Order\"Items" WHERE time > now() - 1h ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50
-- A wider window: WHERE time > now() - 1d
-- One point per minute: SELECT mean("value") FROM "c0".."Order\"Items" WHERE time > now() - 1h GROUP BY time(1m)
-- Another retention policy: SELECT * FROM "c0"."<rp>"."Order\"Items" (SHOW RETENTION POLICIES ON "c0" lists them)
-- Tag values: SHOW TAG VALUES ON "c0" FROM "Order\"Items" WITH KEY = "tag" (on InfluxDB 3 add WHERE time > 0)
-- For the Charts tab: ORDER BY time ASC, and choose time as the x axis.

influxdb3.tableQuery:
-- Newest rows of the last hour. No row means no row is newer: widen INTERVAL '1 hour' below.
SELECT * FROM "c0"."Order""Items" WHERE "time" >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY "time" DESC
influxdb3.selectQuery:
-- Newest rows of the last hour. No row means no row is newer: widen INTERVAL '1 hour' below.
SELECT * FROM "c0"."Order""Items" WHERE "time" >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY "time" DESC
-- A wider window: WHERE "time" >= now() - INTERVAL '1 day'
-- One row per minute: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', "time") AS minute, avg("value") FROM "c0"."Order""Items" WHERE "time" >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
-- Timestamps are UTC with no zone suffix; time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' shows a Z.
